name: aor-kb
description: Preview 0.x: evidence-graded knowledge-base skills for agents. Three skills: aor-kb-query, which searches a knowledge base and returns only claims that clear a trust grade, each stamped with its label; aor-kb-capture, which records what a session learned as a graded claim and routes it to a personal or a work knowledge base; and aor-kb-setup, which wires this machine to a knowledge base you have already cloned and never creates a repository, commits, pushes, or registers a workspace. Routing is fail-closed but it is not a boundary guarantee: it never reads the claim's content and cannot tell work knowledge from personal, it takes its signal from the working directory the command runs in, and its signal lists are empty until you fill them. Windows only; needs Python 3.9 or later on PATH as python, plus the pinned strictyaml in requirements.txt.
